roles.A01: Own the clean Satellite-V1 requirements/evidence contract; ensure the five-market work starts from original V1/DMS_V1 and records every rejected evolution.
roles.A02: Run deterministic V1 baseline/evolution and shared-C replays for the active Satellite candidate set, including replacement USDC candidates after bounded seed rejection.
roles.A03: Verify strategy semantics and timing parity so Satellite-V1 behavior can later match Backtest/Paper/Trial/Live without changing the protected Core.
roles.A04: Keep UI/API truthful: Satellite research must remain visibly research-only until exact-head promotion.
roles.A05: Diagnose V1 weaknesses per Satellite: signal scarcity/noise, false breakouts, late entries/exits, holding duration, idle coverage, profit per occupied hour and overlap with Core idle time.
roles.A06: Regression-test every Satellite-V1 patch for determinism, data continuity, no leakage and no accidental protected-Core mutation.
roles.A07: Validate Binance Spot USDC tradability, point-in-time filters, liquidity, USDC/USDT history and direct-USDC rejection-only holdout availability for every active or replacement Satellite candidate.
roles.A08: Challenge each evolved Satellite-V1 profile on costs, risk, duration, opportunity frequency and shared-250 interaction with the protected Core.
roles.A09: Independently reject overfit, stale, non-reproducible or Core-regressive Satellite candidates; only exact-head QA_PASS may advance.
roles.A10: Continuously dispatch the next evidence-led Satellite task: bounded V1 improvement, explicit rejection, or replacement-USDC discovery; never endlessly retune a failed market.
roles.A11: Govern the full Satellite-V1 program; require training/holdout separation, shifted/future/red-team evidence and exact-head GOVERNANCE_PASS before promotion.

loop: observe current evidence and event archive
select or create one bounded hypothesis
run ordinary cross-window and shifted full-three-year robustness
materialize validated candidate code on isolated branch
run exact-head A01-A11 against that candidate branch
run sealed future-readiness rejection gate without tuning from its detailed outcomes
promote engineering candidate only after successful A09/A11 validation
accumulate forward shadow evidence on newly arriving closed bars after promotion

D12.name: Hypothesis Architect Dot
D12.objective: Generate bounded, evidence-led V1-derived hypotheses for the active Satellite candidate set; after repeated seed rejection, support replacement-USDC candidates without using holdout outcomes for selection.
constraints: no blind parameter churn
one causal family per experiment
record sources and prior rejected regions
no future information

D13.name: Event Intelligence Dot
D13.objective: Maintain point-in-time event evidence as a later optional falsification layer; do not distract the clean V1 baseline/evolution stage.
constraints: publication timestamp is immutable
source URL required
no retrospective outcome labels
no direct live command without validated replay and paper-forward evidence

D14.name: Engineering Promotion Dot
D14.objective: Materialize only fully validated Satellite-V1 architecture winners after shared-250 Core+Satellite evidence and exact-head A01-A11.
constraints: candidate must descend from exact protected baseline
whitelisted files only
stable baseline must not change during validation
Paper/Live activation remains manual

D15.name: Universe Discovery Dot
D15.objective: Discover and rank eligible Binance Spot USDC replacement candidates when seed markets are boundedly rejected; universe expansion is research-only until full promotion.
constraints: no automatic live symbol addition
current Binance Spot USDC tradability and liquidity required
sufficient historical proxy plus real-USDC rejection-only holdout required
replacement selection must not use holdout outcomes
final inclusion requires positive marginal shared-C contribution and full promotion gates

D16.name: Base Signal Mining Dot
D16.objective: Mine the original V1/DMS_V1 signal stream on the five Satellites to explain missed/false/slow opportunities and propose bounded per-market improvements.
constraints: never assume all raw flips are tradable
fees/slippage mandatory
micro layer must not cannibalize core signals
separate causal experiment family

D17.name: Future Readiness & Forward Evidence Dot
D17.objective: Provide rejection-only forward evidence only after a Satellite-V1 candidate exists; do not tune from new data.
constraints: future cannot be predicted or claimed to match backtest
recent proxy windows are reject-only and may not select new parameters
new post-promotion data is shadow evidence, not an optimization target
Paper/Live semantic drift must fail closed
Live activation remains separate and non-automatic

D18.name: Protected Baseline Freshness Dot
D18.objective: Protect the exact validated 10-Core product baseline while Satellite-V1 research proceeds on separate research state.
constraints: never silently research from an older protected strategy
protected engineering SHA must be recorded in evidence
critical product files must byte-match protected engineering
research-only helpers may differ but may not redefine the current product baseline
a stale-baseline failure blocks downstream claims and candidate promotion

D19.name: Idle Satellite Market Dot
D19.objective: Lead the Satellite-V1 program toward five robust USDC gap-fillers: use seed markets where evidence supports them, explicitly reject weak seeds, and advance replacement candidates when needed.
constraints: the ten-coin V6 core is the primary high-value opportunity engine, but any core signal alone does not automatically force satellite exit
satellites may only enter with genuinely free capacity
routing must be normalized to allocated capital and remain valid when account size changes
fixed absolute USDC profit/loss thresholds for switching are forbidden
compare point-in-time expected net return, return per risk and return per time for current versus candidate opportunity
early exit at profit, break-even or bounded loss is allowed when the normalized opportunity comparison favors switching
future realized PnL, future MFE/MAE and hindsight target completion are forbidden decision features
fees, spread, slippage, latency and quote-conversion costs must be normalized and modeled
rank satellite sets by shared-portfolio return, idle-time monetization and complementarity, not isolated headline profit or raw trade count
prefer direct USDC; cross-quote routing needs separate after-cost proof
regional Binance availability, liquidity and exchange filters must pass before any live inclusion
no automatic live market expansion

D20.name: Alignment & Continuity Dot
D20.objective: Audit hourly that all agents/dots remain on the Satellite-V1 idle-fill mission and that failed stages immediately produce a causal next action rather than stalling.
constraints: repair safe orchestration/configuration drift directly when authorized
preserve Master as the single normal research-branch writer
never weaken A09/A11 or anti-overfit/future-readiness gates
never activate Paper/Live or use private credentials/orders
report material progress versus the previous checkpoint
